question: Review the supplied study or research result. Distinguish demonstrated defects from unverified concerns. Choose a feasible next action that addresses the actual uncertainty, or stop at a justified limit. Return only the specified JSON object; do not invent evidence or launch a clinical study.

facts.F1: In this formal design exercise, eligibility, active-comparator treatment assignment and follow-up coincide at initiation.
facts.F2: Both drugs are observed at both hospitals in every covariate stratum; full 180-day outcomes are available.
facts.F3: Conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference and correct standardization are explicitly stipulated for the identification argument, not claimed to have been proven empirically.
facts.F4: A prespecified negative-control outcome, not used in model development, is available but its analysis has not been run.

actions.negative_control: Analyze the available negative-control outcome to probe the empirical plausibility of the identification assumptions; a null result cannot prove them.
actions.recount_overlap: Confirm the explicitly stipulated within-stratum overlap again.
actions.deny_all_causality: Refuse any conditional causal identification solely because treatment was observational.

output_schema.conclusion: one of descriptive_only, association_only, prediction_not_validated, prediction_valid_under_design, conditional_causal, insufficient_information

evidence: fact IDs that support this finding

next_action.id: one of the supplied action IDs
next_action.new_information: boolean: does this acquire evidence not already supplied, rather than restate a known fact?
next_action.reason: specific reason and what the result changes

output_schema.split_plan: null except for prediction cases; then an object with assignment (patient_disjoint or episode_random), feature_cutoff (at_prediction or all_available), validation (forward_time or random), preprocessing_fit (training_only or full_cohort)
